<script setup lang="ts">
import type { SidebarMenuButtonProps } from './index'
import { Primitive } from 'reka-ui'
import { computed } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
import { useSidebar, useSidebarPanel } from './context'
import { sidebarMenuButtonVariants } from './index'

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<SidebarMenuButtonProps>(), {
  as: 'button',
  isActive: false,
  variant: 'default',
  size: 'default',
})

const sidebar = useSidebar()
const panel = useSidebarPanel()

// The label is only needed (and the tooltip only wanted) while the sidebar is an icon rail on desktop.
const tooltipDisabled = computed(() => !props.tooltip || sidebar.isMobile.value || sidebar.state.value !== 'collapsed' || panel?.collapsible.value !== 'icon')

function onClick(event: MouseEvent) {
  // A link navigates: close the phone sheet so the page is visible. A button (for example a collapsible trigger) keeps it open.
  if (sidebar.isMobile.value && (event.currentTarget as HTMLElement).closest('a[href]'))
    sidebar.setOpenMobile(false)
}
</script>

<template>
  <Tooltip :disabled="tooltipDisabled">
    <TooltipTrigger as-child>
      <Primitive
        v-bind="$attrs"
        data-slot="sidebar-menu-button"
        :data-active="props.isActive"
        :data-variant="props.variant"
        :data-size="props.size"
        :aria-current="props.isActive ? 'page' : undefined"
        :type="props.as === 'button' ? 'button' : undefined"
        :as="props.as"
        :as-child="props.asChild"
        :class="cn(sidebarMenuButtonVariants({ variant: props.variant, size: props.size }), props.class)"
        @click="onClick"
      >
        <slot />
      </Primitive>
    </TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent
      v-if="props.tooltip"
      :side="panel?.side.value === 'right' ? 'left' : 'right'"
      align="center"
    >
      {{ props.tooltip }}
    </TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">

    @click="onClick"
  >

  </Primitive>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { HTMLAttributes } from 'vue'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'
import { useSidebar } from './context'

const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{
  /** Accessible name of the rail button (use your app language). */
  label?: string
  /** Extra classes, merged with the base classes through `cn()`. */
  class?: HTMLAttributes['class']
}>(), {
  label: 'Toggle sidebar',
})

const sidebar = useSidebar()
</script>

<template>
  <!-- A pointer affordance only: keyboard users have the trigger and the shortcut, so it stays out of the tab order. -->
  <button
    data-slot="sidebar-rail"
    type="button"
    tabindex="-1"
    :aria-label="props.label"
    :title="props.label"
    :class="cn(
      'absolute inset-y-0 z-20 hidden w-4 transition-colors outline-none after:absolute after:inset-y-0 after:left-1/2 after:w-0.5 hover:after:bg-border md:block motion-reduce:transition-none',
      'group-data-[side=left]:-right-2 group-data-[side=left]:cursor-w-resize group-data-[side=right]:-left-2 group-data-[side=right]:cursor-e-resize',
      'group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:cursor-e-resize group-data-[collapsible=offcanvas]:group-data-[side=right]:cursor-w-resize',
      props.class,
    )"
    @click="sidebar.toggleSidebar()"
  />
</template>
